browser_checks: Synthetic review history displays its submission reference, error code and profile lock
Empty, denied and unavailable lookups clear prior request rows
Editing the customer ID clears the previous customer's history
Setup with request access closed offers only verified self-ID lookup and no customer lookup form
No resend, consent-change, deletion or unlock control is present
limitations: Browser data and identity responses are synthetic. Native runtime testing covers authenticated HTTP through the actual review RPC with empty history; nonempty histories and direct cross-customer review calls are covered in unit tests. Real embedded Shopify authentication and reviewer permissions remain release checks.
